correctness.rationale: PASS: For symmetric reflecting path generator Q_n and classical RK4 step T_n(z)=sum_{k=0}^4 z^k Q_n^k/k!, setting P=I+Q_n/2 stochastic yields polynomial coefficients nonnegative for z<=1/2; this proves a uniform all-n positive interval. For distance-three vertices the exact unique-route walk count gives (T_n)_{i,i+3}=z³(4-z sum_{4 vertices} degrees)/24, so sharp ceilings are 2/3 for n4, 4/7 for n5, 1/2 for n≥6, with negative entry thereafter. Small n=2,3 reduce to monotonic cubic root obstructions (1.392646781702..., .928431187802...); n4,n5 remaining entry types have explicitly positive polynomials at the endpoints and monotonic cubic factors. The RK4 scalar polynomial is strictly positive on nonpositive spectrum, securing diagonal positivity. Independently reconstructed exact rational matrices for n=2..10 and checked thresholds and beyond endpoint; no finite-size extrapolation is needed for n≥6.
